Both managers looked to their benches to evaluate their squads as the new campaign looms on the horizon. A Tactical Battle in the Opening Stages Taking place on August 1, 2026 , the match began as a cagey affair with both sides prioritizing defensive structure. Norwich City attempted to control the tempo through sustained possession, but they found it difficult to break through a well-organized Osasuna backline. The first half was characterized by intense midfield duels and tactical positioning, leaving clear-cut chances at a premium for both sets of supporters. Second Half Breakthrough and Immediate Response The deadlock was finally broken in the 60th minute as the intensity shifted. Norwich City ’s H. Darling found space in the box to fire home a clinical finish, giving the home side a 1-0 lead and igniting the stadium. The advantage, however, was short-lived as the visitors from Spain refused to back down, immediately ramping up their offensive pressure to find a way back into the game. Just seven minutes later, in the 67th minute, Osasuna found their equalizer. R. García displayed great composure to find the back of the net, drawing the scores level at 1-1. The goal shifted the momentum back toward the visitors, though the match remained a balanced contest heading into the closing stages. Late Drama Seals the Result As the clock ticked into stoppage time, the game delivered a final, dramatic twist. In the 90+2 minute, with the match seemingly destined for a draw, A. Bonel struck a decisive blow for Osasuna . The late goal secured a 2-1 comeback victory for the Spanish side, leaving Norwich City with little time to respond. It was a classic pre-season finale that provided plenty of talking points for both coaching staffs.
